_README: Clinical review decisions for the playbook safety copy, keyed by item id.
This file is HAND-MAINTAINED and is the record of sign-off. The checklist
markdown is GENERATED and merges these decisions in, so re-running the
generator never loses a decision that has already been made.
Only the owner (LMFT) can set 'approved' — this is a clinical judgement.

CRISIS_ESCALATION.note: Approved as written. Wording unchanged. Presentation changed instead: the block is no longer collapsed behind a link, it renders as a standing help box on the play screen.

lit-shared-if-you-dont-feel-safe.note: Approved with one addition: the National Domestic Violence Hotline is now named directly (1-800-799-7233, text START to 88788) alongside the existing 'find a domestic-abuse service' guidance, plus a non-US fallback. Deliberately NOT monetised — no affiliate or referral arrangement sits between someone in danger and help.
